title: Bloom Energy Joins Nashville Firefighters to Support Local Students and Families Ahead of Tennessee-Vanderbilt Matchup
summary: $10,000 contribution for the BLAZE Scholarship Program and community initiatives
body_markdown:
**NASHVILLE, Tenn.–(BUSINESS WIRE)–** Ahead of one of Tennessee’s biggest college football rivalries, Bloom Energy is recognizing the people investing in Nashville’s future by supporting local students pursuing higher education.


On Tuesday, Bloom Energy joined Nashville firefighters at Fire Station 19 to present a $10,000 contribution to the BLAZE Scholarship Program. Founded in 2018, BLAZE provides financial assistance to graduating high school seniors and has awarded more than $58,000 in scholarships to help Nashville students continue their education.


“Education creates opportunities that help communities grow and thrive,” said Natalie Sunderland, Chief Marketing Officer at Bloom Energy. “BLAZE is helping Nashville students take the next step toward higher education, and we’re proud to invest in the young people who will shape this community’s future.”


“Every day our team works to make a difference in the lives of our community members and neighbors, many of whom face adversity. One way we support them is through our BLAZE Scholarship Program,” said Director Chief William Swann. “Thanks to Bloom Energy, we are able to meet the increasing needs of our community families this holiday season through our Last Minute Toy Store. This type of community commitment is exactly what makes strong communities even stronger.”


The scholarship program is part of BLAZE’s broader work with young people and families across Nashville. Through mentorship, education, community engagement and service, the organization connects students with support and opportunities beyond the classroom.


BLAZE also leads community outreach initiatives beyond its scholarship program. Its annual Last Minute Toy Express helps provide holiday gifts to local children and families, extending the organization’s work to families across Nashville at a critical time of year.


Bloom’s support for BLAZE continues a series of community engagement alongside ESPN Radio’s College Football Campus Tour powered by Bloom Energy. At stops across the country, Bloom has worked with local organizations serving the communities that host the tour, connecting the national conversation around reliable power and critical infrastructure with direct local action.


The tour arrives in Nashville this weekend ahead of the Tennessee-Vanderbilt matchup, bringing ESPN Radio’s live broadcast and interactive Fan Zone to the community. The stop will highlight the energy and infrastructure required to support growing communities and the institutions people rely on every day.


**About Bloom Energy**
